Tool or resource page named by the toolkit

description: Intermountain West Dashboard is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Western Water Assessment. Access an array of images depicting climate, drought, agricultural conditions, and water-supply monitoring in the Intermountain West region of the United States. Images on the dashboard are updated whenever the original providers update them on their respective websites. Click any image to view a full-sized version. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Flooding – General, Water Quality, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
